page.layout: One printed page, title page with woodcut. Page number at head centre; title block in large italic capitals and italic lines at top; woodcut of a tree with a man beneath it, with a banner inscription along the figure; imprint below the woodcut. Faint show-through of the reverse page (ghost text) behind the title, not transcribed.

main_text.l: ratus, Verbi Dei minister in sacris literis exercitatissimus, ex
theologis omnium huius seculi praestantissimis excerpsit, suumque in eam symbolum contulit.
& artificiose digestus, huic Expositioni communis cum eiusdem
generis Expositionibus in Genesin & in Psalmos,
Excudebat Henricus Stephanus, illustris viri Huldrichi Fuggeri typographus.

page.notes: The banner along the figure in the woodcut reads "NOLI ALTVM SAPERE" (partly obscured). Ghost show-through of the reverse page is present and was not transcribed. The imprint line reads "ANNO M. D. LXIIII" as printed. The woodcut is described only; its banner text is marked as partly illegible.
